schemes.name: UNNATI 2024 Capital Investment Incentive (CII)
schemes.notes: New and substantial-expansion (>=25% addl P&M) units, manufacturing. Min P&M Rs 1 crore; for micro units min Rs 50 lakh and building construction cost counts as P&M (para 8.4-8.5). Cap Rs 10 crore where GST not applicable. Only P&M invoiced on/after 09.03.2024, new, arm's-length. One unit per applicant per state; once per scheme. Overall cap Rs 250 crore per unit across all components. Registration window was 09.03.2024-31.03.2026 (para 5), reported extended to 30.09.2026 (Sikkim Govt news 14-May-2026, quoting DPIIT); as of 2026-10-17 window is closed unless further extended - only already-registered units can claim. Commercial production within 4 years of registration. Negative list: Annexure II (tobacco/pan masala, refinery products, cement, plastic bags <20 micron, arms etc). Notification para 7.3(b): 'New Unit' = registered on/after 09.03.2024 but not later than 30.09.2026; para 5: registration till 31.03.2026; para 6: applications disposed by 30.09.2026.

schemes.name: UNNATI 2024 Capital Interest Subvention - Zone A
schemes.notes: 3 percentage points p.a. on term loan for eligible P&M, max 7 consecutive years; on disbursed amount; loan principal capped at Rs 250 crore; only Scheduled Commercial Banks / RBI-registered FIs; disbursement after commercial production. New and expanding units.

schemes.name: UNNATI 2024 Capital Interest Subvention - Zone B
schemes.notes: 5 percentage points p.a., max 7 consecutive years; same conditions as Zone A.

schemes.name: UNNATI 2024 Manufacturing & Services Linked Incentive (MSLI)
schemes.notes: NEW units only. Incentive = 100% of NET GST paid (gross GST cash paid less ITC; i.e. CGST+SGST/IGST, not SGST only), excluding GST on exports, for max 10 years from commercial production or till scheme validity (08.03.2034) whichever earlier. Total ceiling 75% (Zone A) / 100% (Zone B) of eligible P&M value; paid at max 1/10th of total eligible per FY with carry-forward.
